title: Capture conversation knowledge as note nodes, not native tasks
summary: Durable solo-turn decisions live as overlay-only note nodes in the orchestrator graph (context providers via context edges + suggest_links), kept OUT of the native todo list so they do not clutter the user work queue. Trigger is instruction-based (explicit + conservative auto), not a per-turn Stop hook (would nag and cannot detect whether a decision happened).
